title: Wholesome Crispy British Onion Cottage Pie
description: A monsoon-friendly version of a classic British cottage pie featuring crispy onion toppings and halal-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: ground turkey or lamb (for meat filling)

instructions: Heat shortening in a large pan, add onions and cook until translucent.
Season with salt and pepper, adding shio-koji-cure for desired depth of flavor.
Mix ground meat into onion mixture.
Meanwhile, heat potatoes in water, drain and mash.
Combine mashed potatoes with meat and add shortening.
Pour mixture into a baking dish.
Top with chopped onions from the previous step.
Bake at 200 for 45 minutes or until golden brown on top.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
